reads_as_reason: Silhouette and proportions are adult and clean, but the thigh is a plain rounded slab and the knee has no deliberate joint form, with a hard planar cut on the shank top: a clean placeholder.

G1.evidence: Adult proportions, calf high, shank tapers; thigh is a near-constant-width slab edging toward a box/pill. Failed P8a/P8b agree. One segment is too little for a whole-robot gestalt.

G2.evidence: Bodies flow smoothly (S3a = 0) but the knee does not: flat slanted cut (side view), flat elliptical cap with a hard seam in the back view, hairline gap, no deliberate recess or shoulder.

G3.evidence: Clay only; no obvious recess volume to colour dark.

G4.evidence: Same rounded-rectangle section squareness and end radii; the one outlier is the hard planar cut at the shank top.

G6.evidence: No references. Soft section matches the family; near-parallel thigh and featureless knee do not.

pairwise.evidence: Design-3 has a calm continuous surface and matches the target outline (T1 0.9887 / 0.9862). Design-2 is wavy and lumpy with chaotic zebra and reads as melted. Same knee cut in both; design-3 is cleaner everywhere else.

top_changes.change: Replace the hard planar cut at the shank top with a rounded shoulder and open a clear recess band between thigh end and shank top.
Taper the thigh more strongly from hip to knee (P8a).
Slimmer ankle (P8b) and crown flat faces by lowering squareness (S4a).

notes: One leg segment only; recess colour not rendered. No metric contradicts the images.
